newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ING Barings offers to sell Philippine Yankee bond.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings offers to sell Philippine Yankee bond.

text.p: ING Barings has offered to lead manage a 30-year, dollar-denominated bond of the Philippine government to be issued and sold in the United States, Philippine Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Tuesday.

ING Barings is the third institution which had proposed to underwrite $500 million worth of Yankee bonds. Earlier, Morgan Stanley and Salomon Brothers had presented separate proposals for such issues.
The Philippine government has so far issued dollar bonds outside the U.S. and yen-denominated bonds in the Japanese capital market.
Singson said the tight spread of Philippine debt papers in the secondary market and the low U.S. Treasury bond yield offer "an excellent opportunity to raise long-term, low-cost funding."
Spread of Philippine debt papers to the U.S. Treasury had gone down by almost 50 basis points since the start of the year, he added. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
